notes: IBM's CICS asynchronous API credit-card example: CRDTCHK (the credit check, transaction ICCK). GET CONTAINER(INPUTCONTAINER) INTO the account number; '0001' scores '998', any other '537'; DELAY FOR SECONDS(5); PUT CONTAINER(CREDITCHECKCONT) the 3-byte score; RETURN. Its LINKAGE SECTION is empty: no COMMAREA ("commarea": null). The task starts with the channel its caller passes (#4270, oracle_assumptions.md X24): MYCHANNEL holding INPUTCONTAINER, the 4-byte account number ASYNCPNT / SEQPNT PUT there (no DATATYPE: BIT). The containers the task leaves on MYCHANNEL are compared at its end, as the caller sees them after FETCH CHILD / its LINK. Derived from github.com/cicsdev/cics-async-api-credit-card-application-example (Apache-2.0; Copyright IBM Corp. 2016): LICENSE here is the corpus's own, NOTICE names the source and what was derived.

scenarios.name: account-0001
scenarios.why: '0001': CREDIT-CHECK-RESULT '998', PUT into CREDITCHECKCONT; MYCHANNEL left with INPUTCONTAINER and CREDITCHECKCONT '998'

scenarios.name: no-channel
scenarios.why: no channel: GET CONTAINER without CHANNEL has no current channel -- INVREQ RESP2 4 (caught by RESP), ACCOUNT-NUMBER-IN keeps its initial value (no VALUE clause: oracle_assumptions.md L3) so the ELSE branch runs; PUT CONTAINER is INVREQ RESP2 4 too, then RETURN; there is no channel, so nothing more to compare
